postQuantumHint: Seal direct messages with post-quantum keys when you and the other person both have them and your signer can use them. Anything that cannot be sealed still sends, with ordinary encryption. While this is on, each conversation also shows whether it is quantum-safe.
postQuantumDetected: Post-quantum keys detected on this account.
postQuantumReady: Your signer can send post-quantum messages. While this setting is on, conversations with people who also publish post-quantum keys get the extra seal.
postQuantumSignerUnknown: Your signer does not report post-quantum support, so messages keep going out with ordinary encryption. Obelisk starts using post-quantum on its own once the signer reports it.
postQuantumNotDetected: No post-quantum keys detected on this account.

developer.title: Developer settings
developer.signatureHelp: Request mock signatures for every event kind Obelisk uses. Signed events are discarded and never published.
developer.relayLogsHelp: Log relay calls to the console.
developer.mockContent: Obelisk mock signature test for kind {kind}. This event is not published.

wot.title: Web of Trust
wot.help: Drop events authored by accounts outside your social graph before they reach the cache.
wot.hopsHelp: 1° = direct follows only · 2° = friends of follows · higher = wider net.
wot.pathsHelp: Require this many independent follow paths before trusting a pubkey. Higher values reject single-shill follows; only effective when the extension reports path counts.

calls.title: Calls
calls.fromHint: Calls from anyone else are ignored without ringing.
calls.ipHint: A direct call shows each side the other's IP address. Relaying through our TURN server hides it, at some cost in quality.
calls.relaysHint: Where the call is set up. They only ever see two throwaway keys exchanging encrypted data, so they must accept events from unknown keys: a whitelist relay can't carry a call.

wallet.title: Lightning wallet
wallet.intro: Connect a wallet with Nostr Wallet Connect (NIP-47) to zap and pay invoices from any browser or phone, no extension needed. Your wallet's app gives you the connection link.
wallet.warning: Connecting lets Obelisk spend from that wallet, up to the limits you set in the wallet. Anyone with this link can do the same, so keep it private and set a budget in your wallet.
wallet.budgetRenews: Spending limit: {used} of {total} sats used, renews {period}
wallet.noBudget: Your wallet did not share a spending limit for this app. Check it in your wallet.
wallet.remembered: Stored encrypted in this browser, for this account only. Logging out removes it.
wallet.notRemembered: This browser cannot store the connection safely, so it lasts only until you close or reload this page.
wallet.precedence: While a wallet is connected here, it pays for zaps and invoices, even if a browser extension (WebLN) is also installed.

localData.intro: Obelisk keeps these in this browser to open quickly and remember where you were. None of it is sent to an Obelisk server, and removing it does not touch what you published to relays.
localData.learnMore: Why it is there, and other ways to remove it

removeAll.title: Remove everything from this device
removeAll.description: Logs you out, deletes your encrypted login and everything listed above, then reloads.

confirm.all: Everything Obelisk keeps here is deleted: your login, the wallet connection, cached messages and profiles, read positions and alerts, preferences, mutes, blocks and saved stickers, offline files, your language choice and the analytics cookies. You are logged out and the page reloads. To log in again you need your key, your browser extension or your signer app. What you published to relays is not affected.
confirm.channels: Cached channels and messages are deleted from this device and the page reloads. Everything loads again from the relays; nothing you published is affected.
confirm.profiles: Saved names and pictures are deleted and the page reloads. They load again from the relays.
confirm.readState: Read positions, unread counts and alerts on this device are deleted and the page reloads. Read positions synced through your relays come back; alerts do not.
confirm.dms: Your encryption choice for each person is forgotten and the page reloads. Your messages are not affected.
confirm.preferences: Your settings, layout and recent items go back to the defaults and the page reloads.
confirm.personal: Mutes, blocks, channel notification choices and saved stickers made on this device are deleted for good and the page reloads. They are not stored anywhere else.
confirm.login: You are logged out on this device and the page reloads. To log in again you need your key, your browser extension or your signer app. Cached channels and messages and the wallet connection are cleared too.
confirm.wallet: The wallet connection is deleted from this device and the page reloads. To zap or pay again from Obelisk, paste the connection link from your wallet's app. The wallet itself and its funds are not affected.
confirm.offline: The saved app files are deleted. Obelisk downloads them again the next time it loads, and will not open offline until then.
confirm.language: Obelisk forgets the language you picked and goes back to your browser's language. The page reloads.
confirm.analytics: The Google Analytics cookies are deleted. They are set again the next time a page loads; to keep them away, block trackers in your browser.
